say:0:1623202001:0.text: Let's hear what they're talking about.
say:0:1623202001:0.source_cn: 不如用变形术听听动物们在聊什么。
say:0:1623202001:0.male: Let's hear what they're talking about.
say:0:1623202001:0.female: Let's hear what they're talking about.

say:0:1623203001:0.text: Lord Owlbear, you gotta listen, like, right now!

say:2:1623204001:0.text: Lord Owlbear, two strange newcomers have shown up in the forest...
say:2:1623204001:0.source_cn: 枭熊大人，最近森林里来了两个怪家伙……

say:4:1623204002:0.text: Yes! Yes! The moment they pop up, my tail ties itself into a panic knot!
say:4:1623204002:0.source_cn: 对对对！只要他们一出现，我就吓得尾巴打结！

say:7:1623204004:0.text: Easy, all of you. One at a time. What do they look like, and where were they seen?
say:7:1623204004:0.source_cn: 好了好了，你们一个一个说。你们说的怪家伙，长什么样？在...

say:9:1623204005:0.text: Well... One of 'em goes swish-swish nonstop, and the other's got a big FLAME on his head! I almost dropped my acorns!
say:9:1623204005:0.source_cn: 他们……一个总是沙沙响，另一个还顶着一团火！吓死个松鼠了！

say:11:1623204006:0.text: They first turned up near the wheat fields. Lately, they've been edging toward the forest... Everyone's getting nervous.
say:11:1623204006:0.source_cn: 起初是在麦田附近出现的。最近他们似乎想进森林，大家都有...

say:13:1623204007:1.text: A-And I... I found this. The swishy one dropped it...
say:13:1623204007:1.source_cn: 我……我捡到这个。是那个沙沙响的家伙掉的……

say:15:1623204009:0.text: Yeah! That's why we came to you! You've seen more than anyone!
say:15:1623204009:0.source_cn: 对对！所以大家才想来请教您嘛！您见识最广了！

say:17:1623204010:0.text: Understood. I'll keep an eye on it. Go back, now. Stay alert, but try not to scare yourselves.
say:17:1623204010:0.source_cn: 我知道了。这件事我会留意的，大家先回去吧，保持警惕，但...

say:18:1623204011:0.text: Sooo, Lord Owlbear... when are you gonna go handle it exactly?
say:18:1623204011:0.source_cn: 所以枭熊大人你什么时候去解决？

say:20:1623204012:0.text: Hey, Lord Owlbear always gets it done. Let's head back.
say:20:1623204012:0.source_cn: 好啦，枭熊大人答应的事肯定会做的。我们走吧。

say:23:1623204014:0.text: But it has been a while since you visited the woods. Everyone's really missed you!
say:23:1623204014:0.source_cn: 不过的确好久没见枭熊大人来森林了，动物们都很想念你呢！
